'''''Hammer''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] created by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]]. It was assigned to a small fleet under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vocis Kenit]] during his search for the vessel ''[[Far Orbit]]'', which had committed mutiny against him.
